questions.question: Extractive QA 预测什么？
options: Start and end token indices of the answer span within a given passage
questions.explanation: Extractive QA 输出包含答案的段落片段 (span)。

questions.question: 基础 RAG 流水线的两个组成部分是什么？
options: An encoder and a decoder trained jointly
A retriever (find relevant passages) and a reader (extract or generate the answer)
questions.explanation: RAG = retriever（找到相关上下文）+ reader（从中回答）。

questions.question: 在 SQuAD 上，Exact Match (EM) 测量什么？
options: Whether the prediction matches the reference exactly after normalization (lowercase, strip punctuation, remove articles)
questions.explanation: EM 是定义归一化后的严格相等；部分匹配得分为零。

questions.question: deepset/roberta-base-squad2 相比 SQuAD 1.1 模型增加了什么？
options: Training on unanswerable questions so the model can predict a null answer
questions.explanation: SQuAD 2.0 包含无法回答的条目；在其上训练的模型可以预测 'no answer'。

questions.question: RAGAS 的哪个维度专门针对幻觉 (hallucination)？
options: Faithfulness, measured by NLI entailment between answer claims and retrieved context
questions.explanation: Faithfulness 通过 NLI 蕴含 (entailment) 检查每个答案主张是否与检索到的上下文一致。

questions.question: 为什么应该在评估 reader 准确率之前先测量 retrieval recall（检索召回率）？
options: If the correct passage is not in the top-k, the reader cannot succeed regardless of how good it is
questions.explanation: 当正确段落缺失时 reader 无法回答；retrieval recall 决定了 reader 性能的上界。

questions.question: 哪种提示词 (prompt) 模式可以减少 RAG 生成中的幻觉？
options: Telling the model to answer only from the provided context and to reply 'I don't know' when the context is insufficient
Asking the model to be creative
questions.explanation: Grounding + 显式拒答指令能大幅降低幻觉率。

questions.question: 在 2026 年，什么时候抽取式 QA (extractive QA) 仍然优于生成式 RAG？
options: Regulated domains (legal, medical, audit) where literal quotation from authoritative sources is required
questions.explanation: Extractive QA 能从权威语料库中给出逐字引用，这是合规场景所要求的。
